Compare Soundscaper Desktop with Soundscaper Web. For all editors, reviewed sources, and rating conventions, see [How Soundscaper compares](/start/how-soundscaper-compares/).

`+` means supported, `~` means limited, `/` means unavailable, and `?` means not verified. Hover, focus, or tap an underlined cell for its qualification. Ratings cover built-in features and the hosting capabilities explicitly listed.

[Choose another comparison](/start/comparisons/)

## Platform and terms

| Capability | Soundscaper<br>Desktop | Soundscaper<br>Web |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Licence | + — AGPL-3.0-only | + — AGPL-3.0-only |
| Cost | + — Free | + — Free |
| Runs in a browser | / | + |
| Runs on Windows | + | + |
| Runs on Linux | + | + |
| Runs on macOS | + | + |
| Runs on BSD | / | + |
| Works with no account | + — :: Local editing needs no account; optional sharing has its own sign-in | + — :: Local editing needs no account; optional sharing has its own sign-in |
| Cloud project storage | ~ — Manual archives :: Manual AUP3/AUP4 archive storage on a configured Audiocity server; no automatic sync | ~ — Manual archives :: Manual AUP3/AUP4 archive storage on a configured Audiocity server; no automatic sync |

[Web or desktop](/start/web-or-desktop/) covers platform limits. Optional sharing does not automatically back up a Soundscaper project; see [storage and backups](/projects-and-data/storage-backups-and-privacy/).

## Project format support

`+` means read and write; `~` marks one-way or incomplete support. Hover for
conversion limits. External converters do not count. Media must accompany
formats that reference separate files.

| Format | Soundscaper<br>Desktop | Soundscaper<br>Web |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Soundscaper (`.sscape`) | + — :: Original media is referenced by default; consolidation bundles it for portability. | + — :: Browser saves bundle media. Consolidate desktop projects before opening them in a browser. |
| Audacity (`.aup`) | ~ — Import :: Imports the legacy project and its companion media; no AUP export. | ~ — Import :: Imports the legacy project and its companion media; no AUP export. |
| Audacity (`.aup3`) | + — :: Audio-only import/export, with a compatibility report; Soundscaper-only state can be omitted. | + — :: Audio-only import/export, with a compatibility report; Soundscaper-only state can be omitted. |

| Cool Edit / Audition (`.ses`) | ~ — Import :: Recognized legacy binary layouts only; unsupported state and missing media are reported. No export. | / |
| Audition (`.sesx`) | ~ — Import :: Imports audio tracks, clip placement, trims, simple fades, and static mixer settings. Effects, automation, routing, and other unsupported state are reported; no SESX export. | / |

## Interchange with other tools

Both Soundscaper editions import and export EDL, OpenTimelineIO, FCPXML, OMF,
AAF, and DAWproject.

| Capability | Soundscaper<br>Desktop | Soundscaper<br>Web |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EDL | + — :: Import and export CMX3600 cuts; export uses one selected sequence track. | + — :: Import and export CMX3600 cuts; export uses one selected sequence track. |
| OpenTimelineIO | + — :: Import and export audio/video tracks, gaps, and supported nested stacks. | + — :: Import and export audio/video tracks, gaps, and supported nested stacks. |
| FCPXML | + — :: Import and export timeline spines, asset clips, and connected lanes. | + — :: Import and export timeline spines, asset clips, and connected lanes. |
| DAWproject | + — :: Imports and exports media and supported project structure, with an exchange report. | + — :: Imports and exports media and supported project structure, with an exchange report. |
| OMF | + — :: Import and export OMF2 audio. Export embeds mono/stereo 24-bit WAV, with a 256 MiB decoded-PCM limit. | + — :: Import and export OMF2 audio. Export embeds mono/stereo 24-bit WAV, with a 256 MiB decoded-PCM limit. |
| AAF | + — :: Import and export audio cuts and embedded media; unsupported processing and picture are reported. | + — :: Import and export audio cuts and embedded media; unsupported processing and picture are reported. |
| Round-trip with a video editor | ~ — Framescaper copy :: File-menu handoff creates a separate editable Framescaper copy, with a conversion report | ~ — Framescaper copy :: File-menu handoff creates a separate editable Framescaper copy, with a conversion report |
| Blender track export and live sync | + — :: WAV track bundle and one-way edit updates through the bundled Blender 4.2+ add-on | / |
| Labels and markers exchange | + | + |
| AES31 ADL | / | / |

Transfers can omit unsupported state; review the exchange report. See [project formats](/projects-and-data/project-files/), [Blender sync](https://github.com/LeoWattenberg/Soundscaper/blob/main/docs/development/desktop-blender.md), and [Framescaper handoff](https://github.com/LeoWattenberg/Soundscaper/blob/main/docs/decisions/product-origins.md).

## Verdict totals {#verdict-totals}

Each comparison row counts once, including individual export formats. Products
are sorted by `+` count, then `~` count to break ties. These totals measure
coverage of the listed features: row selection and granularity affect the order.
They do not measure implementation depth, audio quality, performance, or reliability.

<!-- comparison-summary -->
